notes.title: Patch #1 (Update:Live)
notes.content:
[b]Hi Everyone, [/b]
We hope you're all having tons of fun with Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom! Today we'd like to give you an update on what we've been working on to improve your experience. The first patch is going to be released soon (it's currently in testing). Here's some information on it [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33065817/237246caf886045805fcbedd6d6b11d8ac069ac8.png[/img]

[b]Patch #1 includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ring Menu:ON[/b] setting will get a QoL update. If you liked the current functionality, nothing changes for you. Additionally it will be possible to hold the key, choose the transformation/magic with the L-Stick and confirm by just releasing the key. This way the ring menu will be faster to use.
[*]  Better stability in sound module when the sound device is removed or unplugged. (we received crashlogs which showed issues here).
[*] Fixed a camera glitch in Lost Temples region.
[*] Fixed menu navigation issue when a specific amount of items was stocked.
[*] Jukebox songs play to the end properly (2 songs have been buggy)
[*] Low performance mode: If you run below 30fps the game will now execute render updates to avoid physics issues with jump height and water currents.
[*] Fixed graphical bug in background with a specific level.
[*] Once you entered volcano area, small savespots will revive you with 5 hearts refilled instead of 3 in case of failing.
[*] Fixed spawn position of a crate in the forest that was buggy when playing with unlocked framerate above 120fps.
[*] Improved fullscreen video setting to hopefully prevent low resolution startup bug that was reported by some players.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

we hope you're all enjoying summer! BTW: Please play Bloodstained! ^_^

Today we'd like to inform you about a new update of the demo, addressing the crash bugs that some users encountered. It was caused by non-Ascii character Windows User names and should now be fixed. Please update the demo and try if it works now.

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 
there's a new demo build available for everyone. Please check it out in case you encountered problems with the initial demo release. 

[b]Here's a quick info about changes/updates:[/b]

- The sound effects should now play normally when using a multichannel setup
- Ultrawide has a dynamic HUD setting to align the HUD with the screen edges.
- DualCore Support
- Crashlogs will be written locally so you can send them to us.
- Dialogue Text Size can be increased in the options.
- Improved high framerate play
- Fixed a bug on Ultrawide screens that caused Shop Items to disappear.
- Framerate Limiter function improved
- Automatically uses Nvidia hardware on Laptops with intel & Nvidia option.

Thanks for your help and support!

Next Update coming soon! ^_^

notes.title: Developer Update #4
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 
we planned to release the Monster Boy Demo in April but we missed it, sorry! 
It’s coming soon but we think it’s also worth the wait. We unlocked the Framerate and we’re close to have it working nicely. The whole team is hard at work to deliver the best possible experience.

[b]Here's a preview of the video settings menu:[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33065817/6f657c07aa38e29c26bad70b454f4cddfd8e8e0d.jpg[/img]

[b]Some explanations about this menu:[/b]

- You can freely choose the resolution, also ultrawide+
- Framerate is unlocked unless you activate Framerate Limiter or/and VSYNC
- Screen Shakes: Avoids any camera shaking for players who're sensitive to that
- Texture Quality: You can drop the texture quality to run the game stable with ~1GB VRAM (e.g. on intel GPU Laptops). You'll be able to test it with the upcoming demo.
- Reduce Flashing light: Full screen white flashes are eliminated to reduce the risk of epilepsy for players who're sensitive.
- Ultrawide Border Design: We designed very neat dynamic borders that'll fill any ultrawide screen if the level isn't wide enough (e.g. narrow passages or boss rooms). You can choose between 2 interactive designs or simple black borders (3 options total).

As a response to your feedback in Developer Update #3: We’ll include Xbox One, PS4 and NSW Pro Controller symbols in the game. We're testing the game with Xbox 360, Xbox One, PlayStation 4, Switch Pro and Steam Controller. When the demo is out, please test with your own controller and let us know if it works properly for you.

Thank you for your patience! ^_^

tags.feature: - You can freely choose the resolution, also ultrawide+

- Screen Shakes: Avoids any camera shaking for players who're sensitive to that
- Texture Quality: You can drop the texture quality to run the game stable with ~1GB VRAM (e.g. on intel GPU Laptops). You'll be able to test it with the upcoming demo.
- Reduce Flashing light: Full screen white flashes are eliminated to reduce the risk of epilepsy for players who're sensitive.

- Ultrawide Border Design: We designed very neat dynamic borders that'll fill any ultrawide screen if the level isn't wide enough (e.g. narrow passages or boss rooms). You can choose between 2 interactive designs or simple black borders (3 options total).
We’ll include Xbox One, PS4 and NSW Pro Controller symbols in the game.

notes.title: Developer Update #3
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 
we implemented all PC related features and the game has now entered our QA where we test it thoroughly on multiple setups. Once we finished the majority of tests, we'll release the free demo. We expect to release the demo this month. If the demo runs well on the majority of machines, we'll release the full version, otherwise we'll fix what needs to be fixed first. We want to make sure that PC players have a great 'Day1' experience with the full version of Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom. 

[b]Some information about the PC features: [/b]

Version: The PC Version is based on the latest console version which received 3 patches since the release. The game is really complex and we could iron out many things that will improve the whole 20-25 hours gameplay experience.

Controls: Monster Boy will support various control methods and you can configure it to your liking. Use a controller, keyboard or/and mouse and freely map it. Here's a question to you: If you pick a controller to play the game, which one would it be?

Ultrawide Monitors: Several levels and scenes in the game are wider than 16:9 so we unlocked them to display fullscreen on ultrawide monitors. Other scenes like boss fights remain 16:9. We needed to add a feature to blend these nicely. You'll be able to test this ultrawide feature in the demo and your feedback is welcome. We want to make y'all happy and enjoy the game to the fullest on your PC's.

Alright ...so the next Developer Update will be the Demo release then!  ^_^

We needed to add a feature to blend these nicely.

notes.title: Developer Update #2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 
while we work on the PC version and the Steam release, we wanted to give you another update today: [b]We'll launch a free demo of the game first!
[/b]

We hope that many players will try it on their machine and give feedback so we understand how well it runs on various configurations. We want to make sure that the game runs fine for a big audience before wrapping up the full release. There's only a certain amount of configurations we can test ourselves and we hope to get even more results after the demo release. 

In return for your cooperation and support while testing the demo, we're going to set a lower purchase price for the PC release compared to consoles. Please look forward to the release of the demo and stay tuned for more Developer Updates in the future. <3

tags.feature: We'll launch a free demo of the game first!
